description: Duplex in good area of Tujunga! Includes 2 remodeled units each 1 bedroom/1 bath, each with W/D hook ups and private backyard. Great investment for residential and/or owner-occupied use or commercial (if purchased with property next door 6851 Foothill blvd $529,999) !  Additional highlights all copper plumbing, new electrical panel, newer roof, include 3 paver parking, potential adding 2nd  ADU development opportunity in the backyard and potential about 5% cap rate.  There is also the opportunity to buy one contiguous property next door, currently listed for sale $549,999, with the potential owning 3 rental units. Centrally located near schools, supermarkets, restaurants, and just minutes from all the vibrant restaurants and coffee shops in downtown Glendale, Burbank, Silver Lake, Atwater Village, Walt Disney Studios and the Rose Parade route. This treasured duplex reflects true pride of ownership and is a superb investment property that will not last long in this hot market!
